description: Obtaining financial assistance for the Sector Development Programme (Sub‑programme 1) on Building a Strong and Inclusive Financial Ecosystem for Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-16 to conduct loan negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to secure a Policy-Based Loan of USD 620 million structured under five sub‑programmes, in order to advance                   Sri Lanka’s reform agenda in parallel with the International Monetary Fund's Extended Fund Facility programme. As per the said approval, the Department of External Resources has now concluded formal loan negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the relevant funds for the implementation of Sub‑programme 1 of the  Sector Development Programme on Building a Strong and Inclusive Financial Ecosystem for Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into an agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan consisting of a Policy‑Based Loan Component of USD 100 million and a Financial Intermediation Loan Component of USD 100 million, funded through the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources of the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.
